Finding: No authoritative effective-dated vehicle allocation lifecycle is clearly demonstrated.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Create separate lessor and lessee allocation aggregates with overlap enforcement.

Finding: Vehicle is selected directly in agreements, mixing commercial terms with operational assignment.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Remove hard binding; connect agreements through effective-dated allocations.

Finding: Same-vehicle overlapping allocation prevention is not proven.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Enforce deterministic timeline locking and overlap constraints.

Finding: Agreement and rate version snapshots are not proven.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use approved immutable effective-dated rate versions and transaction snapshots.

Finding: Running Chart finalization and same-side duplicate consumption protection are unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Introduce explicit lifecycle, customer/owner facts, and unique consumption records.

Finding: Posted financial screens expose edit/delete-style controls.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Make posted records immutable; correct only through governed reversals and adjustments.

Finding: Procedures/reports exist for allocation, double-entry, and source-to-GL mismatches.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Post source, Tax, and Finance atomically and enforce reconciliation invariants.

Finding: Cross-module reversal coordination is unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Implement source-aware reversal coordinators with compensating history.

Finding: Concurrency safety for allocation and payment consumption is not proven.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use DB transactions, deterministic locks, idempotency, and expected versions.

Finding: Password Register and opaque numeric user-level patterns are legacy security risks.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use secure hashing, named permissions, role policies, and audit logs.

Finding: Vehicle-owner and leasing-company lessor flows are duplicated.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use shared Lessor identity and role-specific policy without duplicating the lifecycle.

Finding: Vehicle ownership history is not clearly effective-dated.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Create ownership-period history and validate allocations against it.

Finding: Unified vehicle availability across rental, workshop, accident, and document status is absent.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Create a shared availability contract and timeline.

Finding: Insurance and revenue-licence expiry are visible but enforcement is not proven.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Block handover/allocation when required documents are invalid.

Finding: Handover and return appear as separate documents rather than authoritative custody events.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use append-only custody events with odometer, fuel, condition, actors, and evidence.

Finding: Replacement-vehicle charging and usage splitting are unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Obtain business sign-off; store explicit policy decision per replacement.

Finding: Odometer continuity is not proven.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Validate previous/next usage and custody readings.

Finding: Driver overlap and multiple-driver split rules are unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Confirm rules; enforce timeline conflicts and explicit assignments.

Finding: Agreement approval/execution evidence is weak.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use explicit approval, execution, legal snapshot, and state transitions.

Finding: Suspension, extension, renewal, termination, and penalty policies are unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Capture stakeholder decisions; do not infer defaults.

Finding: GL and Tax mappings are embedded in agreement/invoice forms.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Move mappings to semantic effective-dated posting profiles.

Finding: Raw account, party, and vehicle codes dominate UI inputs.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use human-readable searchable selectors and related objects.

Finding: Customer credit-limit and overdue enforcement is not proven.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Enforce backend credit policy at approval/posting.

Finding: Fuel and repair deductions exist but approval/evidence/responsibility rules are unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Require source evidence, approval, agreement policy, and immutable adjustment.

Finding: Security deposit lifecycle is incomplete or unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Model requirement, receipt, apply, refund, forfeit, balance, and reversal.

Finding: Generic debit/credit notes may bypass original commercial context.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Require source document, semantic reason, evidence, and approval.

Finding: Refund identity and refund-of-refund behavior are unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Require original payment, opposite direction, scope/party/currency validation.

Finding: Cheque bounce, stop, cancel, and replacement lifecycle is unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use explicit cheque-status events and governed accounting.

Finding: Accounting-period close and backdated-posting control are not evidenced.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Implement open/soft-close/close/reopen with posting and reversal validation.

Finding: Financial reports may not be authoritative while source-to-GL mismatch can exist.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Require source-to-journal completeness and drill-down reconciliation.

Finding: Dense forms mix commercial, Tax, and GL concerns.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Separate primary tasks from advanced accounting configuration.

Finding: Calculation inputs appear duplicated across agreements, invoices, and payables.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Centralize policy and freeze calculation snapshots.

Finding: Manual GL code selection creates drift and entry risk.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use account roles and configured posting profiles.

Finding: Checkbox/button lifecycle is ambiguous.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use explicit state machines and allowed-transition APIs.

Finding: Audit actor, reason, and previous-value visibility is weak.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use append-only events and human-readable audit timeline.

Finding: Attachments, signatures, and condition evidence are incomplete.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Store handover/return documents, photos, checklists, and signatures.

Finding: Search and selection are code-heavy.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use autocomplete, labels, previews, and guided relationship controls.

Finding: Report drill-down to source facts is unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Link reports to immutable source, calculation, document, Tax, and journal records.

Finding: Idempotency for repeated create/post commands is not proven.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use source fingerprints and idempotency keys.

Finding: Tenant/organization isolation is not visible in the legacy design.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Use tenant-scoped identities, FKs, queries, and authorization.

Finding: Historical retention and correction explanations are unclear.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Preserve originals and record separate reversals/adjustments.

Finding: Irreversible actions lack clear impact guidance.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Add previews, warnings, and reason capture for posting/reversal.

Finding: Duplicated menus and flows increase maintenance risk.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Consolidate shared flows while retaining clear role-specific ownership.

Finding: Workshop and rental availability are not integrated.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Expose availability-blocking events through a shared contract.

Finding: Important calculations may remain operator knowledge rather than explicit policy.
Recommended Root-Cause Fix: Capture signed-off rules as effective-dated configuration and tests.
